Coefficients

Source: R/coef.R
coef.kb_fit.Rd

Posterior summaries of the model terms, as returned by tidy().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
coef(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A kb_fit object.

...

Passed to tidy().

Value

A tibble with one row per term and columns term, estimate, lower, and upper.

See also

Other fit methods: augment.kb_fit(), fitted.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_samples(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), residuals.kb_fit(), summary.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

Examples

coef(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
#> # A tibble: 7 × 4
#>   term           estimate    lower  upper
#>   <chr>             <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 intercept       -0.666  -0.918   -0.421
#> 2 diameter_power   2.92    2.71     3.13 
#> 3 weight_floor     0.118   0.098    0.14 
#> 4 sd_site          0.2     0.0406   0.521
#> 5 sd_year          0.0544  0.00298  0.254
#> 6 sd_site_year     0.261   0.179    0.372
#> 7 sd_residual      0.463   0.438    0.488
